partnershipPlan: A family council representative from each home reviews the information given to residents and families before rounds start and the lay summary of results; the directors of care review the deputy role.
socialListening: No social media listening; the homes' compliment and complaint logs for the last year are read for comments about medicines.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I did not mind them stopping Mum's cholesterol tablet; I minded hearing about it from the pharmacy bag.
items.implication: Tell families before a change and record their view in the round note.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase (nurse in charge): When she was away we just cancelled, because none of us felt we could run it.
items.implication: Train and support a named deputy in each home.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase (resident): Nine tablets at breakfast is a meal in itself.
items.implication: Report medicine counts in terms residents recognise.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase (attending physician): If the round is next to my visit I will be there; if it is on another day I will not.
items.implication: Schedule rounds next to the physician's regular visit.

summary: Four composite voices on family communication, deputies, pill burden and scheduling.
